violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles with various condiments throughout prep line and cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Label all secondary containers with food name.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed staff changing tasks, using the restroom and re-entering the kitchen, or entering the facility after a take out delivery and did not wash his hands,
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS INSTRUCTED MANAGEMENT ON WHEN STAFF SHALL WASH THEIR HANDS. SEE FACT SHEET PROVIDED IN EMAIL.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. Observed no handwashing signage at any hand sink throughout facility.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. PIC ordered handwashing signs during inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw, shelled eggs and raw ground beef were stored on shelves above cheese and/or spinach.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS HAD THE MANAGER RE-ORGANIZE THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. Observed cooked, portioned noodles at 46f-50f in multiple cook line refrigeration units. Manager stated the foods were prepared the night before.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC discarded noodles.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cut turkey (45F), cut tomato (52F) in 3 DR prep (middle); garlic bread prepared with fresh garlic and oil stored below stove (62F), spinach at the pizza station (46f), pizza sauce on counter (67f).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded items and/or moved to working refrigeration if under 4 hours.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Observed ‘Tylenol’ stored on shelf above 4 DR pizza prep.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC relocated ‘Tylenol’ away from food prep area.

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed cleaning chemicals stored directly next to food processors.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC relocated food processors to shelf above cleaning chemicals. PAISANO'S SUBS AND PIZZA (Inspection Date: 09/08/2025) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed cleaning chemicals in spray bottles with no label.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC provided label for all chemicals stored in spray bottles.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: cooked pasta stored in bags stacked together in deep pan in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS discussed proper cooling methods with PIC, specifically utilizing freezer and cooling items in shallow pan to cool items properly. EHS provided cooling method handout via email and discussed how to cool down hot foods rapidly.

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device was found out of calibration in the range of use. Observed food thermometer provided by PIC at 35F in ice water.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. PIC ordered new food thermometer during inspection.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 drawer under stove, 4 DR prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. Please obtain an ambient air thermometer for any unit missing a display thermometer.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: oils, spices at cook line; flour at prep area, liquid margarine, shakers of spices, sugar, etc.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS discussed proper labeling procedures. Ensure all foods removed from original containers are properly labeled and please ensure continuous compliance before the follow up.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Openings to the exterior of the building are present along the rear kitchen door. Door was also observed propped open.
violations.corrective_action: Fill or close holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO KEEP THE DOOR CLOSED AT ALL TIMES AND TO INSTALL PROPER DOOR SWEEPS ON THE BASE OF THE REAR DOOR TO SEAL UP THE GAP BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed scoop with no handle in container used to store bulk foods like sugar, flour, etc.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC shall provide new measuring cups or food scoops that have handles. The handles shall sit up, out of the food during storage. Ensure continued correction before the follow up.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of spices. Observed paprika spice container used to store oregano.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS discussed proper use of manufacturer containers. Please ensure containers used to store spices are not reused. PAISANO'S SUBS AND PIZZA (Inspection Date: 09/08/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Observed single service/take home containers/catering containers and lids displayed or dispensed with the food or lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO TURN THE ITEMS UPSIDE DOWN WHILE IN STORAGE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine. Observed no heat sensitive test strips or dish plate to verify temperature for heat sanitizing dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Please obtain heat sensitive test strips or a dish plate. EHS will verify compliance within 10 days.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved mop splitter at mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC disconnected unapproved mop splitter during inspection and ordered approved mop splitter during inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed small gaps/holes in kitchen ceiling panels where electrical wiring, plumbing, etc are located.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO SEAL UP ANY GAPS/HOLES IN THE CEILING PANELS BEFORE THE FOLLOW UP TO PREVENT INSECT OR RODENT ENTRY.

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. EHS INSTRUCTED THE MANAGER TO HANG OR TURN THE MOPS UPSIDE DOWN TO ALLOW FOR AIR DRYING. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION FOR THE FOLLOW UP.
